name: pixdcon2
description: pixdcon 2.0: controller for Pixoo64 and Ulanzi/AWTRIX pixel displays (rewrite of pixdcon v1, same repo, image pixdcon2)
author: Markus Barta

scripts.//: Developer notes: PAIMOS knowledge 'guideline pixdcon-2-interfaces' (project PIXD). dev = v2 against fake devices and an in-memory MQTT broker, restarted on every change under src/. test = the three approved kinds only (golden frames, API/MQTT contract, fake-device smoke), together under 60 s. Every test script goes through test/helpers/run.js: it preloads dev/net-guard.js (only loopback is reachable, also for Node child processes, worker threads, DNS and UDP, so no real display, broker or host is ever contacted) and holds the run to a hard deadline: a single test is cut after 20 s, the whole run ends with exit code 1 after 55 s, and what is still alive then is killed. sites = the inventory of asynchronous input (dev/async-sites.js): every place in src/ and web/ that consumes a message, an event, a timer or an answer, against test/contract/async-sites/W1.json … W5.json; sites:update rewrites the line numbers of the rows after code moved, and nothing else. The release version is ../version.json (inspr-calver-3), not the version field above.
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
